transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… eating is the main thing. Sometimes when I’m alone in the kitchen, once I start, it feels like I can’t really stop myself, even though I’m telling myself, “Janet, put it away.” It scares me a bit.
When you’re eating and you feel like you can’t stop, does it feel like you’ve lost control, like you can’t stop eating even if you wanted to?
Yes… that’s what it feels like. Like I’ve sort of stepped aside, and even though I’m telling myself, “Janet, put it away,” I just… can’t seem to make myself stop. It’s scary.
After these episodes of eating where you feel like you can’t stop, do you ever try to make up for it by making yourself sick or using laxatives?
I… I don’t really know. I don’t think so. I mean, that’s not something I usually do.
After these episodes of eating where you feel out of control, have you ever tried to make yourself sick, used laxatives, or done something else to try to compensate for the food you ate?
No… I don’t think I do those things. I just feel bad afterward, but I don’t usually try to… undo it like that.
Do you feel distressed, guilty, or ashamed after these episodes of eating where you feel out of control?

Yes… I do. I feel really ashamed afterward. Like I’ve wasted food I meant for other people, and… I don’t know, like I’m too old to be acting that way. I usually just sit there feeling awful and tell myself it won’t happen again.
How often do these episodes happen, and are they tied to specific situations or emotions?

I guess… looking at my kitchen calendar, and the weeks I go to the food bank, it’s been most weeks. Maybe once or twice in a week. It’s been going on for months now, I think. Usually it’s worse when I’m upset or feeling overwhelmed, but… I don’t always know exactly why.
After these episodes where you feel out of control with eating, do you ever fast, exercise excessively, or misuse medications like diet pills or diuretics to try to compensate?
Not really… I mean, I don’t go do a big workout or take pills or anything like that. Sometimes I might skip a meal because I feel bad, but I wouldn’t say I’m doing it in some planned way.

When you’re having one of these episodes where you feel out of control, do you feel like you’re eating an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time, more than other people would eat in the same situation?

Yes… I think so. Like, some afternoons after I’ve been at the food bank or baked something for the senior center, I’ll come home and it just… keeps going. Leftovers, then banana bread, chips, cheese, cookies if they’re there.

Afterward I look at it and think, that’s way more than I’d ever put on a plate for someone else.
How many months would you say this has been going on, where you’ve had these episodes of feeling out of control while eating?
Um… about a year, I guess. Maybe a little more. Around fourteen months… since my friend from the food bank died.
Do these episodes of eating where you feel out of control usually happen in a short amount of time, like within a couple of hours, and do you tend to do them alone because you feel embarrassed?

Yeah… usually it’s in an afternoon, not all day. I’ll get home and it happens over maybe a couple hours.

And I do tend to be by myself. I don’t really want anyone seeing me eat a plate of leftovers and then banana bread and chips and cheese and cookies after that. It’s… embarrassing.
